house-treehouse.title: House and treehouse
house-treehouse.status: Read-only review at9f045ebca, report6566215080. Original178 tests are reconciled into reviewed house groups and explicit tools/UI/save/MP/combat handoffs. Extra rebucketed neighbors remain separately listed until reviewed.
house-treehouse.keepSummary: safe floors and interactions, exactly-once events, layout/editor identity, hat conservation and direct equipment/kitchen rules
protections: Floors, walls and corridors keep stations reachable and landings safe.
Hats retain ownership and occupied points through drops, overflow, reload and return.
Bed, landing, collection and ingredient-credit events occur once.
Editor data round-trips and validates camera-facing conversion without changing archived layout evidence.
Classic-layout and older camera options remain explicit supported comparisons.

groups.title: Simulated house travel observations
groups.reason: Three mixed cases pin a bed-to-Terrace journey under26s, follower arrival within12m after40s, and later posse proximity after90/20s. Preserve floor/reachability, takeoff, sigil identity/order, no manufactured sigils and guard-assignment release.
groups.question: Split these three travel tests so their time/proximity observations become nonblocking reports? Yes retains floor, reachability, transition, identity and eligibility checks as blocking tests.
examples: are walked from her bed down the trunk to the Terrace's take-off, on the floor all the way (and how long it takes: Ed, 2026-10-24)
head into the home area to spots of their own and guard there, not to her: no sigil put down, her stack unchanged
follow her again once she's off the treehouse: travelling to her while she flies, then her posse round her once she lands
exampleLabels: The bed-to-Terrace journey meets a time target.
Followers reach their house spots within a sampled window.
Followers regroup after leaving within a sampled window.

groups.title: Movement, interactions and camera contracts
groups.reason: Floor containment, one-time actions, blocked panels and reachable stations are direct protections. Current walk speeds/dimensions, rise permissions and camera easing remain authored rules. Explicit old-camera/house-off modes are supported comparisons, not proven dead code.

groups.title: Layouts, editor and hat conservation
groups.reason: Serialization, validation and conservation assertions remain alongside current placement/default policy. Archived proposal audits validate historical evidence rather than asserting an old object count as today’s complete layout. Waiting through knockdown does not make hat ownership a balance outcome.

groups.title: Equipment and kitchen contracts
groups.reason: Remaining component arithmetic/exclusivity, ingredient reservation, landing credit and timed-effect state transitions are direct house rules. The nine combat/invitation kernels are not included in this keep group.
groups.question: Keep this group unchanged?
examples: parts fitted together add up (Ed's doc: 'Stats from different parts add up')
no broom completes two at once (every one of the 64)
reserves three ingredients in flight; starts smoke on the third plop, not keypress
exampleLabels: Fitted broom parts add their stated effects.
A broom cannot complete two spell sets at once.

rulings: Layout supersession: house.md37 records the saved proposal approved as the default after guest-wake releasev6703 (1553#6547631190,1476#6548948298). Plain links/layout=ed select it; layout=classic retains the older arrangement. housePlacement:11 explicitly compares false/true modes rather than the global default. H2 proposes descriptions only, preserving classic-module identity and occupant conservation.

Bed route: houseConfig:27 names the old93m mock, while its actual assertion is99m following the26Oct corridor/bed move. H2 updates the description to the route already asserted, not the expected value.
Treehouse direction: DESIGN105’s5Oct due-north placement was replaced by24Oct north-west. treehouse:143 already checks north-west. No behavior deletion is needed.

Broom stations: house.md100 records29Oct’s single station at the lathe, replacing separate bay/pegboard interaction. houseRooms:156 and stations:179 enforce the replacement. No-broom takeoff restrictions and broom-enabled takeoff are conditional rules, not contradictions.

Cross-owner mixed kernels in nine broom/hat/guard cases are excluded from the combined house keep question and listed under1622. Stealth windows, hit counts and Cyclone turn/height/fling percentages are not certified as house integrity merely by appearing in equipment files. Other handoffs:11 measurement-tool tests,3 changelog UI tests,3 mushroom-stock save tests and9 MP boundary tests are counted on their owner pages once. No whole house behavior was proved obsolete.
